title: Earnings Statement Glossary: Amount of a Hold-Release Payout
content:
**Hold-release payout (amount).** Under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**, the hold-release payout is the whole available balance on the driver's earnings account at the moment the payout hold is lifted. The hold-release payout is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, and is never below zero.

## The definition, part by part

| Element | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Source figure | The available balance shown on the earnings account at the moment the hold is lifted |
| Rounding | Half up to the cent, once, at the end |
| Floor | Never below zero: a balance at or below zero gives a hold-release payout of 0.00 |

## Hypothetical worked figures

| Available balance when the hold is lifted | Hold-release payout |
|---|---|
| 238.45 | 238.45 |
| 0.00 | 0.00 |
| -42.10 | 0.00 (never below zero) |
| 57.125 (an unrounded hypothetical figure) | 57.13 (half up to the cent) |
